payload.claim: `_stale_push_state`'s docstring says "Neither state is ever re-entered (`SA-0331`)", extending a claim that in the base code was made only about `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` to also cover `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE`, but still citing only `SA-0331`. `SA-0331`'s own text traces the no-resume argument explicitly for a `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` row ("The same trace covers a `REBUTTAL_UNJUDGED` row with a `pr_url`") and nowhere performs or claims that trace for `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE`; `SA-0331` even scopes its own push guard to leave `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` out. The generalization to `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` is actually argued in this task's own background (via `REQUEUE_STATES`, `saffron package`'s resume rule and `saffron adopt`'s refusal), not in `SA-0331`, so the citation points a reader at a spec that does not say what the sentence now claims for half of the states it covers.
